The machine forwards the four stack words in original order to GameInput::OnMouseUp at 0x00697af0, whose own body reads ESP+4 as the button index, ESP+8 as mouseX, ESP+0xc as mouseY, and ESP+0x10 as the state word, and the local retcount of 0x10 proves four stack words. The implementation therefore models an ECX receiver plus four stack words.

In this function the pair is laid out with the first forwarded pointer at frame offset 0xc and the second at frame offset 0x0, which is the reverse of the 0x00e6c860 frame where the first pointer is at 0x4 and the second at 0x10.

state_contract.return_is_constant_true: There is no early exit and no conditional branch in the body; AL is one on every path.
state_contract.no_mouse_state_test: The mouseState word is forwarded to GameInput and then never tested. Unlike 0x00e6c860 this function has no mouseState dispatch gate.
state_contract.no_button_comparison: The mouseButton word is forwarded and then never compared; unlike 0x00e6c860 there is no 0x3e8 or 0x3ea test.
state_contract.no_pick_call: 0x00e6c780 is not called; the raycast is unconditional.
state_contract.screen_coordinates_are_not_forwarded: The renderer layer slot receives no stack words, so mouseX and mouseY reach only GameInput::OnMouseUp. The two float words written into the outgoing argument area before the layer call are dead stores for a zero-argument call.
state_contract.raw_bit_behavior: mouseX and mouseY are forwarded as the four-byte representation of each float.
state_contract.output_buffer_is_persistent: The raycast writes into the Cell state buffer at offset 0x100 rather than a frame buffer, and the following epilogue does not clear it.
state_contract.zero_float_width: The offset 0x904 store is a four-byte MOVSS write of 0.0f produced by XORPS, not an eight-byte or integer zero.
state_contract.health_word_is_the_return_value: The offset 0x900 word is the signed 32-bit 0x00e87200 result and is not masked, clamped, or range checked.
state_contract.callback_order: GameInput forward, renderer acquisition, layer slot, integer unproject, raycast, offset 0x900 store, offset 0x904 store, return true.

implementation_deviations: The two dead float stores into the outgoing argument area at 0x00e5c103 and 0x00e5c10b are not reproduced, because the renderer slot call consumes no stack words.
The reuse of the PUSH ECX slot at 0x00e5c143 to hold the 0x014851e8 float with FSTP [ESP] is not reproduced; the observable effect is only the sixth 0x00e87200 word.
0x0067dd10, the renderer slot, 0x007c4900, and 0x00e87200 are represented as package-owned ports with the recovered argument and cleanup contracts rather than as raw native function pointers.
